name: qaeverest
description: An AI QA copilot in Cursor's agent: generate functional, API, UI, mobile, integration and database test cases (from a story, a spec, or your own code), run automation suites, test AI agents, and run security and performance checks. The QAEverest MCP server as tools and prompts, with skills that tell the agent when to reach for them.

QAEVEREST_API_KEY.title: QAEverest API key
QAEVEREST_API_KEY.description: Your QAEverest API key (starts with qae_). Get one free at https://qaeverest.ai/api-client/signup, or from Admin → API Management in your QAEverest account.

QAEVEREST_API_URL.title: QAEverest API URL
QAEVEREST_API_URL.description: Backend base URL. Leave as the default unless you run a self-hosted or enterprise QAEverest instance.
